declaration.reason: Implement the owner-approved fail-closed REAL/TRIAL meeting deletion boundary. A meeting is REAL by default; only an administrator explicitly creating it as TRIAL can mark it TRIAL. Environment is immutable after creation. Only administrators may delete explicitly TRIAL meetings, with all existing safeguards retained. REAL, missing and invalid environments are non-deletable.
declaration.expectedEffect: Prevent deletion or final purge of any REAL or unclassified meeting. Permit only administrator deletion of an explicitly TRIAL meeting after existing safeguards. No other portal behavior changes.
prohibitedChanges: Never delete REAL or unclassified meetings.
Do not weaken administrator authorization, legal hold, retention, pending-review or version checks.
Do not change signing, sign-in, invitations, email-link rules, SMTP, secrets, Firestore rules or production deployment.

behaviourDifferences: Only the exact TRIAL marker at creation qualifies; REAL, missing, invalid, lowercase or whitespace-padded values are non-deletable.

activeAmendment.reason: Owner-authorised 24-hour repair of typed signer-address routing for envelope creation, parallel invitations, signer-specific resend and resend-all, SMTP delivery recording, privacy-safe audit email and per-signer delivery visibility.
activeAmendment.expectedEffect: The typed signer-row address, trimmed and lower-cased, is the sole recipient source. SMTP RCPT TO and the single-recipient To header are identical. Parallel mode sends independently to every signer position; resend and resend-all use each signer record's own address. Every invitation has a unique Message-ID, text and HTML parts, the IRPA Digital Signing From name and a position-specific subject. One best-effort audit email per final SMTP outcome records EAT time, envelope, position, Message-ID, creation/resend, reply category or stage code, and only the first three local-part characters plus full recipient domain. The per-signer panel displays Not sent, Sent, Accepted by the mail server with category/time, or Failed with stage code; no Delivered label.
prohibitedChanges: Signing rules, token format/hash custody, link format, sessions, signer identity, resend eligibility/rules or field assignment.
PDF stamping, document hash, certificate, archive logic or completed PDFs.
Firestore rules, secrets, environment variables, SMTP settings, credentials or Worker bindings.
Authentication/authorization rules, GitHub branch protection, or any policy bypass.
Self-test crash handling, Meeting Portal behavior, hash verification, rebuild or unrelated portals.
